title: Sel Roti
description: Sel Roti is a Nepal dish made with white rice, whole cow milk, banana. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Soak the listed rice, grains or noodles in clean water for about 360 minutes as appropriate, then drain; grind rice and urad for batter if required by this dish.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Form ring-shaped portions of thick ground rice batter with a central hole, then fry until both sides are golden and cooked through.
Fry shaped portions in small batches in oil heated to about 170–175°C for about 22 minutes, until golden; drain on a rack.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
